fn AlternatingSum(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 1) then -1 else (AlternatingSum((n - 1)) + (if ((n % 2) == 0) then n else -n))))
  effects pure
  example (AlternatingSum(1) == -1)
  example (AlternatingSum(2) == 1)

fn solve(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 0)
  ensures (result == AlternatingSum(n))
  ensures ((not ((n % 2) == 0)) or (result == (n / 2)))
  ensures ((not ((n % 2) != 0)) or (result == ((n / 2) - n)))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0) == 0)
